identity.name: nanoCMS Route, Navigation and Sitemap Projection

purpose: Define deterministic read-only projection of site/page structure into routes, navigation, breadcrumbs and sitemap output.

owns: nanoCMS Route, Navigation and Sitemap Projection semantics

topics.name: nanoCMS Route, Navigation and Sitemap Projection
topics.purpose: Define deterministic read-only projection of site/page structure into routes, navigation, breadcrumbs and sitemap output.

semantics.source_rule: Projection reads exact accepted site/page/navigation structure.
semantics.route_rule: Route output preserves explicit route bindings.
semantics.nav_rule: Navigation output uses exact visibility/order/label metadata.
semantics.sitemap_rule: Sitemap is derived projection, not canonical site structure.
semantics.failure_rule: Duplicate/unresolved route causes explicit validation failure.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.

hard_gates.condition: generated sitemap becomes source of truth
duplicate routes resolved by last file

references.purpose: Projection derives from exact page tree.
